name: Chinarestaurant Phönix
kurzbeschreibung: Chinese Restaurant Phönix in Füssen – A culinary gem in the heart of the Allgäu, where authentic flavors from the Orient meet the charm of Bavaria.
beschreibung: The Chinarestaurant Phönix in the Außerfern region delights its patrons with a wonderful selection of regional and seasonal specialties. The kitchen artfully weaves traditional alpine culinary traditions with modern creative notes, creating a unique feast for the senses. The inviting décor invites guests to settle in comfortably, while the attentive service ensures every wish is met. A warm recommendation is the homemade dumpling soup, a true comfort after outdoor excursions. In addition, an enticing wine list offers handpicked selections from Austria and South Tyrol.
